gap: No result ChatGPT got states what each pick costs on 2026-11-21 once its maker's hardwire kit is added (parking mode needs one): DDPAI N5 Pro $187.51 with no card to buy (64 GB built in), 70mai A810 Gift Box $199.99 with kit and 256 GB card in the box, Vantrue S1 Pro 2CH $165.98 plus a card, and VIOFO A229 Plus 2CH $177.98 plus a card only at the $159.99 retailer price, since viofo.com lists it at $229.99.
standout_why: Compared against DashCamTalk, PCWorld and knowledgelib.io (cited), plus productbible.com and truepicked.com; vortexradar.com returned HTTP 403 and was not read. DashCamTalk, PCWorld and productbible give camera prices only, and knowledgelib says in terms that kit prices are missing. Truepicked is the partial overlap: it adds camera + kit + card, but for the A229 Pro ($232), Vantrue N4 ($237), 70mai A810 ($207 plus an unpriced kit) and Redtiger F9 ($187) at April 2026 prices, none of them a ChatGPT pick. If the same method on other models counts as 'part of it', score this 1. The per-model recording-hours figure I wanted could not be sourced, so this angle rests on the all-in total alone.
decides: It confirms the A229 Plus 2CH as the pick only at the $159.99 retailer price ChatGPT showed (kit total $177.98, $22.02 left for a card); at VIOFO's own store it is $229.99 and off the page. It gives our DDPAI N5 Pro an honest segment: 4K front + 1440p rear with parking power and storage for $187.51 through our link, with no card to buy, valid until code SAVEBIGBF ends 2026-11-30; at the $179.00 store price the same pair is $208.99, over budget. The 70mai A810 Gift Box ($199.99, one cent under) is the only single-box complete kit I found, and the Vantrue S1 Pro 2CH leaves the most room for a card ($34.02).
